changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: 25B Sorghum Varieties
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of 1000FARMS project to introduce new varieties in the Rwanda seed systems.
study.objective: Comparing 5 varieties of Sorghum in Rwanda

location_privacy.method: Each site displaced to a random point within a fixed radius, reproducible per site id. Sites published in release v1 keep their v1 coordinates.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

funder.5: We recevied this grant as sub-grantees of the main grant given to Bioversity-CIAT alliance
